title: Account Settings
description: The place to manage all your account details

desc.profilePicture: Upload a profile picture to personalize your account.
desc.username: The name that identifies you on the platform.
desc.displayName: The name displayed to other users.
desc.email: The email address you use to log in to your account.
desc.password: Set a strong password to protect your account.
desc.dateOfBirth: Set your date of birth, and we'll give you a surprise!
desc.twoFA: Enable two-factor authentication when logging into the system.
desc.oauth: Configure OAuth providers to enable third-party logins.

enable2FA.title: Enable Two-Factor Authentication
enable2FA.description: Please scan the QR code below with your preferred authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, and click proceed.
enable2FA.confirmationDescription: Please enter the OTP shown in your authenticator app to confirm enabling 2FA.

disable2FA.title: Disable Two-Factor Authentication
disable2FA.description: Are you sure you want to disable two-factor authentication?

twoFA.disableFailed: Two-factor authentication could not be disabled.
twoFA.setupFailed: The setup code could not be loaded.
twoFA.verifyFailed: The code was not accepted. Try the current code from your authenticator.

oauth.changeConfirm: Are you sure you want to change the OAuth credentials?
oauth.changeAlert: Updating the client ID and secret will replace existing ones. This action is not reversible.
oauth.keepBlank: Leave a field blank to keep its saved value. A supplied value replaces it, and saving enables this provider.
oauth.saveFailed: The provider could not be updated.
oauth.removeDescription: Remove this provider’s saved credentials and sign-in option?

messages.avatarFailed: The profile picture could not be saved.

validation.credentialChange: Enter a new client ID or secret.
validation.otp: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator.
